en.title: Proof of a Logical Void
en.premise: A Memory Auditor receives a contradictory request: "My memory of a murder has been stolen." To corner the true culprit, they must logically reconstruct the fragmented memories scattered throughout the market. However, the very void within those memories is the only clue pointing toward a cruel truth.

zh.title: 《逻辑缺失之证明》
zh.premise: 记忆审计师接到了一个充满矛盾的委托：“我的杀人记忆被盗了。”通过逻辑性地重构散落在市场中的碎片化记忆，他试图逼近真凶。然而，那段记忆的空白，正是指向残酷真相的唯一线索。
